title: iOS Supercross game
author: x2waaVe
selftext:
What’s up everyone

This is an idea I’ve had for a while, just agents have made it come to fruition

Main Event Supercross has a beta which you can find the link in their Instagram bio

It’s a first or third person dirt bike game that’s a healthy mix of simcade. Started off in swift, recently ported to unity. Game looks good but could look a whole lot better🤘🏽

comments.author: SizzlingPancake
comments.body: That looks cool. What is the control scheme like?

replies.author: x2waaVe
replies.body:
Just added controller support. 

Default touch control scheme is one thumb for gas + steering and lean. A second finger acts as the brake. Also have a classic layout with gas, brake and clutch buttons on screen like HUD. 

I enjoy playing it in portrait mode with the default scheme
